items.title: Voorbereiding Eredivisie: onder meer ADO, Cambuur en Utrecht komen in actie
items.summary: In dit overzicht zetten we de oefenprogramma's van de Eredivisie-clubs op een rijtje. Het nieuwe seizoen in de Eredivisie begint op 7 augustus met de wedstrijd SC Cambuur - Excelsior.

items.title: Blind man of the match bij Ajax-terugkeer: 'Ik kan de trainer helpen'
items.summary: Daley Blind is helemaal terug bij Ajax. De 36-jarige verdediger, die na afloop van de zege op Vojvodina werd uitgeroepen tot man of the match , is blij om weer in een Ajax-shirt te voetballen.

items.title: Geen vragen: coach Ferencváros loopt na twintig seconden weg bij persconferentie
items.summary: Als er geen vragen zijn, dan is het niet nodig om te blijven zitten. Dat zou Ferencváros-trainer Balázs Borbély hebben gedacht na de zege van zijn ploeg op bezoek bij FC Twente. De Hongaarse coach kreeg geen enkele vraag van het aanwezige journaille en kon dus op tijd de bus in.

items.title: Ajax oogst lof in Servische media: 'Tegen dit Ajax heb je niets te willen'
items.summary: Servische media zijn donderdagavond onder de indruk van Ajax. De nationale pers zag hoe Vojvodina in eigen huis geen schijn van kans had tegen Ajax, dat in de tweede voorronde van de Conference League met afgetekende cijfers won: 1-4 . 'Dit had rampzalig kunnen eindigen.'

items.title: Hongaarse media wijzen twee uitblinkers aan en waken voor return tegen FC Twente
items.summary: De Hongaarse media zijn verbaasd over het resultaat van Ferencváros op bezoek bij FC Twente. De bezoekers uit de Hongaarse hoofdstad wonnen met 1-2 , maar de media zagen dat het allerminst verdiend was. Twee spelers sprongen erbovenuit bij Ferencváros.

items.title: Defoe leaves Woking after 'eye-opening' first managerial role
items.summary: Former England and Tottenham striker Jermain Defoe has described his first managerial job as an "eye-opening experience" following his departure from National League side Woking after just four months and nine matches in charge.

items.title: From Popp to Diani: 10 women’s transfers you may have missed during the men’s World Cup
items.summary: Sam Kerr’s and Alexia Putellas’s moves were hard to miss but these transfers may have escaped your attention There were a host of big women’s football transfers which were hard to miss across June and July, despite the dominance of the men’s World Cup. Among them were Beth Mead’s move from Arsenal to Manchester City, Mary Earps and Georgia Stanway returning to the Women’s Super League with London City Lionesses and Arsenal, Sam Kerr leaving Chelsea to return to Gotham FC and, most prominently, Alexia Putellas’s game-changing switch from Barcelona to London City. But here are 10 transfers you might have missed while attention was focused on the action in the US, Canada and Mexico. Continue reading...

items.title: Chelsea paid Aston Villa £117m for Morgan Rogers. Is he the right fit?
items.summary: The England attacker thrives when he can gallop into space but Xabi Alonso’s best team built attacks slowly By Opta Analyst It quickly became apparent this summer that Aston Villa would not be holding on to Morgan Rogers. Having helped the club finish fourth in the Premier League and win the Europa League, the 23-year-old was in demand. Arsenal looked like his likeliest next destination, with the champions eager to strengthen the left side of their attack. The charm offensive came from many angles, with Martin Ødegaard, Mikel Arteta and the club’s England players trying to sell the idea to Rogers. But, with Arsenal reluctant to meet Villa’s asking price, Chelsea intervened and made Rogers the most expensive British player ever, surpassing the £116m that Manchester City paid Nottingham Forest for Elliot Anderson earlier this summer. Continue reading...

items.title: Elliot Anderson lauds City as ‘kings of Manchester’ after £116m Forest transfer
items.summary: ‘They’re winners, relentless, a team I want to be part of’ Midfielder hails De Bruyne as a childhood inspiration Elliot Anderson has called Manchester City the “kings of Manchester” after completing his £116m move to the club from Nottingham Forest. The 23-year-old was a key part of England’s third-place finish at the World Cup, having been an ever-present for Forest in the Premier League last season. Before Morgan Rogers’ £117m transfer to Chelsea from Aston Villa on Tuesday, Anderson’s fee was the record for a British player. Continue reading...

items.title: Aston Villa seal loan signing of Alejandro Garnacho from Chelsea
items.summary: Argentinian surplus to requirements at Chelsea Deal follows Morgan Rogers’ switch to Stamford Bridge Aston Villa have confirmed the loan signing of the Chelsea winger Alejandro Garnacho, as a summer of change continues at Villa Park. The deal for Garnacho’s season-long loan includes a conditional obligation to buy a player who joined Chelsea last August from Manchester United in a deal worth £40m. Villa will be expected to pay a similar fee for Garnacho, who struggled to impress at Stamford Bridge despite featuring in 43 games in all competitions and scoring eight goals. Continue reading...

items.title: ‘Don’t become the protagonist’: Andoni Iraola on the secret of Spain’s success and his role at Liverpool
items.summary: Liverpool’s new head coach is settling into the pre-season tour in Chicago as he begins to reshape the Reds’ identity Over coffee in Liverpool’s plush hotel in Chicago, Andoni Iraola presents his theory for the phenomenal success of Basque and Spanish coaches. It is a theory that will shape his entire approach to life as the Liverpool head coach and his attempts to bring the connection, the joy and the belief back to Anfield. It centres on the power of the collective. The Champions League, the Premier League, the Europa League, the FA Cup, the League Cup, the European Championship and, as of Sunday, the World Cup: all currently in the hands of Basque and Spanish coaches, even if Pep Guardiola has since taken his leave from Manchester City. Next season, four men from the small Basque region of Gipuzkoa will manage four of the Premier League’s main contenders, Iraola included, alongside Mikel Arteta, Xabi Alonso and Unai Emery. There is, Iraola believes, a simple explanation for the rise of the guys from Gipuzkoa and for Spanish dominance across a global stage. Continue reading...

items.title: UPDATE: Groen licht voor Mark van Bommel bij KBVB
